blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines—Reigning champions University of San Carlos (USC) Warriors and Don Bosco Technical College (DBTC) Greywolves both blanked their respective opponents in the Cebu Schools Athletic Foundation, Inc. (CESAFI) Season 26 football tournament on Sunday, September 27, at the Cebu City Sports Center (CCSC) pitch. The Warriors, the longest-reigning champions in the collegiate division, cruised past the University of the Philippines (UP) Cebu Fighting Maroons, 4-0, to seize the top spot in the team standings. USC opened the scoring early through Areli Acuin Gaspe in the fifth minute before adding three more goals in the second half. Renzo Angelo Enriquez […]...
